name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
extDescription: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of Transcendent Wings. Tribute this face-up card on your side of the field to destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent''s side of the field and inflict damage to your opponent''s Life Points equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s). You can only activate this effect during your opponent''s Battle Phase.

name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
extDescription: A flame manipulator who was the first Elemental HERO woman. Her Burstfire burns away villainy.

name: Elemental HERO Clayman
extDescription: An Elemental HERO with a clay body built-to-last. He'll preserve his Elemental HERO colleagues at any cost.

name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
extDescription: An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.

name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
extDescription: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
extDescription:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
extDescription: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand). When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Black Luster Soldier
extDescription: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Luster Ritual".

name: Cyber Dragon

name: Chthonian Soldier
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.
